# Async Swap

An MEV-capturing DEX built as a Uniswap v4 hook: an on-chain order book and matching engine for limit orders against USDC, matched by price, priority bid and time. Priority bids auction ordering to the protocol and a dynamic fee returns backrun profit to LPs.

- [Async Swap, an MEV-capturing on-chain order book DEX on Uniswap v4](/index): An MEV-capturing DEX built as a Uniswap v4 hook. An on-chain order book and matching engine for USDC limit orders, where priority bids auction ordering to the protocol and a dynamic fee returns backrun profit to LPs.
- [Async Swap protocol map](/protocol/overview): Contracts, custody, fees and authorization of the Async Swap hook, in diagrams: permissionless pools, minimum order and asset floor fixed at deployment, Router.multicall.
- [Order lifecycle and priority bids](/protocol/order-lifecycle): How an order is placed, matched, filled, repriced and cancelled, how priority bids are paid, and how to cancel and withdraw claims in one Router.multicall.
- [Priority fee top-ups](/protocol/priority-fee-top-ups)
- [Contract call sequences](/protocol/contract-call-sequences): Step-by-step contract calls for opening pools and placing, matching, filling, cancelling (alone or batched) and redeeming orders.
- [Price keys and crossing](/protocol/price-key-crossing): How limit prices map to price keys and when two orders cross.
- [Dynamic fee ordering](/protocol/dynamic-fee-ordering): How Async Swap captures backrun MEV with a dynamic fee on pool fills that move the price back, split between LPs and the protocol.
- [Deployments](/deployments): Contract addresses and faucets for the three testnets (Unichain Sepolia, Robinhood Chain testnet, Elysium testnet); no mainnet yet. Also at /deployments.json.
- [Audit scope: Async Swap (2026-11-05)](/audit/scope): Audit scope: frozen commit, files in scope, trust assumptions, known issues and the status of every previous finding.
- [Contract reference](/reference/): Contracts, libraries, interfaces and types, generated from the NatSpec in src/.
- [AsyncSwap](/reference/src/AsyncSwap): Uniswap v4 hook that converts an exact-input swap into an open async order: the maker deposits their input via `_beforeSwap`. Crossing orders settle directly at the resting limit; fillers settle unmatched orders.
- [FeeVault](/reference/src/FeeVault): Holds and redeems protocol fee claims, never maker escrow.
- [ImmutableState](/reference/src/ImmutableState): A collection of immutable state variables, commonly used across multiple contracts
- [MatchingEngine](/reference/src/MatchingEngine): Standalone price-time matching harness. It maintains a radix-indexed limit book and emits deterministic fill instructions.
- [NativeClaims](/reference/src/NativeClaims): Redeems the caller's PoolManager native ETH claims to a chosen recipient.
- [Router](/reference/src/Router): Thin entrypoint for makers (`swap`, `topUpPriorityFee`, `cancelOrder`, `cancelAndWithdraw`, `withdrawClaims`), fillers (`fillOrder`) and keepers (`matchBook`, `fillFromPoolLiquidity`), batched with `multicall`. Each action goes through `IPoolManager.unlock` so the hook can operate on PM debts. Native payouts/refunds are PoolManager claims (ID 0), redeemable through NativeClaims or `withdrawClaims`; ERC20 payouts remain direct.
- [TokenClaims](/reference/src/TokenClaims): Redeems the caller's PoolManager currency claims to a chosen recipient.
- [BaseHook](/reference/src/BaseHook): abstract contract for hook implementations
- [IFeeOwner](/reference/src/IFeeOwner)
- [IAsyncSwapCallback](/reference/src/interfaces/IAsyncSwapCallback): The Router's callback fill surface: `fillOrderWithCallback` opens a fill and calls the filler back (`IAsyncSwapFlashFiller.asyncSwapFlashFill`); the `...InCallback` functions are the only Router calls accepted while that callback runs, and only from its filler. Every other Router entry point reverts `FlashFillActive` until the callback returns.
- [IAsyncSwapFlashFiller](/reference/src/interfaces/IAsyncSwapFlashFiller): Callback a filler contract implements to use `Router.flashFill`.
- [ISignatureTransfer](/reference/src/interfaces/ISignatureTransfer): Minimal subset of Uniswap Permit2's SignatureTransfer interface used by the Router. Canonical Permit2 lives at 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3 on every chain.
- [IIncomingLiquidity](/reference/src/libraries/IIncomingLiquidity)
- [AsyncFiller](/reference/src/libraries/AsyncFiller): Stores open async orders and settles fills against them.
- [AsyncMatching](/reference/src/libraries/AsyncMatching): Linked matching module operating on the hook's order and radix-book storage.
- [ClaimTransfers](/reference/src/libraries/ClaimTransfers)
- [CurrencySettler](/reference/src/libraries/CurrencySettler): Production copy of v4-core's test-only `CurrencySettler`, using safe transfers so tokens that return no data from `transfer` / `transferFrom` (e.g. USDT) settle correctly.
- [DynamicFeeOrdering](/reference/src/libraries/DynamicFeeOrdering): Linked library called by `AsyncMatching` in the hook's context.
- [EligiblePrice](/reference/src/libraries/EligiblePrice): Exact-price summaries on a priority-key radix tree.
- [IncomingMatching](/reference/src/libraries/IncomingMatching): Fund a crossing arrival, match it in memory, then index only its remainder.
- [OrderSignatures](/reference/src/libraries/OrderSignatures): EIP-712 types for signed AsyncSwap actions. Every type spells out the maker, both tokens and the amounts so wallets render a readable message instead of opaque calldata.
- [PriorityFeeUpdates](/reference/src/libraries/PriorityFeeUpdates): Funded priority amendments, linked separately to keep the hook within EIP-170.
- [RadixPriceTree](/reference/src/libraries/RadixPriceTree): Patricia radix index for uint128 price levels. Inserts and removals traverse at most 128 branch bits; each distinct price creates one leaf and at most one branch node. Node ids released by `remove` are recycled by later inserts, so the id counter only grows with the peak number of simultaneously stored prices and can never be exhausted in practice (2^31 simultaneous levels).
- [TickBitmap](/reference/src/libraries/TickBitmap): Three-level occupancy bitmap for the bounded tick-key domain.
- [TickPrice](/reference/src/libraries/TickPrice): Book levels on Uniswap v4 ticks: an order sits at the floor tick (spacing 1, 0.01% steps) of its exact currency1/currency0 limit. Levels are a fixed relative width at any price and for any token decimals; the exact limit still decides crossing within a level.
- [TokenTransfers](/reference/src/libraries/TokenTransfers): Require full ERC-20 delivery without charging extra to the sender; token-reported success is insufficient.
- [AsyncOrderLibrary](/reference/src/types/AsyncOrderLibrary): Helpers attached to AsyncOrder for identity and pricing.
- [AsyncOrder](/reference/src/types/AsyncOrder): Represents an async order for a swap in the Uniswap V4 pool.
